name: FORM Coach Console · Agent Map
purpose: Machine-readable orientation for authorized assistants. This file contains no private athlete or owner data and grants no access.

public_method.precedence: Individualized current coach decisions and restrictions outrank generic doctrine examples.

authentication.required: existing verified FORM coach membership, with additional active owner authorization for personal operations
never: infer identity from an email or repository access
use a service-role credential in the browser
bypass Row Level Security or an approval step
assume an unavailable source means zero records

navigation.name: Today
navigation.owns: operating items, priorities, waiting, source freshness receipts
navigation.read: operating_console_read from the authorized owner session
navigation.caveat: Calendar, Finances and email are projections with observed_at and source_as_of; browser refresh does not recheck those external providers.

navigation.name: Athletes
navigation.owns: athlete case-file presentation, observations, private notes and evidence views
navigation.read: loadCoachBench and loadAthleteRecord under an authorized coach membership
navigation.caveat: The dossier is a reader and observer, not a second plan database.

navigation.name: Programming
navigation.owns: session authorship, versioned revisions, coach reads and decisions, coach filing, publication queue
navigation.read: loadCoachRoster and loadAthleteRecord through the existing authorized client
navigation.caveat: Drafted, saved, published, externally delivered and native released are separate states.

navigation.name: Group sessions
navigation.owns: shared Thursday/Saturday publication, individualized pace adjustments and Week-story reviews
navigation.caveat: Saturday mileage remains athlete-specific; a gathering requires an actual hosted run. Preview must be current before publish.

navigation.name: Runs
navigation.owns: hosted run occurrence, guests, attendance, and run photographs
navigation.caveat: An event invitation or RSVP does not prove attendance or completed training.

source_states.live: fresh read from canonical source; preserve observed timestamp
source_states.snapshot: checked copy; source_as_of may predate observed_at
source_states.stale: expired source check; recheck owning provider before using
source_states.conflict: different sources disagree; reconcile before publishing or acting
source_states.unavailable: read failed or access missing; never silently substitute zero
source_states.pending: result not yet verified or published

workflow: Read current records, source versions, restrictions and the Method Bible.
Identify intended capability, skill repetitions, training stimulus, recovery cost and nearby demanding work.
Show a specific proposed action and its owning system. Coach authorizes meaningful athlete programming decisions.
Write only through existing authorized owner functions with their version/revision constraints.
Read back the exact version and athlete-facing Week, and verify feed when a filing should be shared.
Report verified result, source timestamp, unknowns and any blocked cross-app connection. Never call a draft live.

freshness.external_provider_rule: A browser reread of a stored projection does not refresh its source. Recheck the original provider with an authorized connector and update the source receipt.
freshness.failure_behavior: Show the last successful read timestamp and an explicit stale/error state; preserve existing records.

method_laws: Train to win means follow the plan and progressions; do not race workouts.
Appropriate effort in the right session, plus strength, mobility and recovery, prepares the athlete for decisive sessions and competitions.
Glute development is a default priority with individualized dose and medical exceptions.
Author complete progressions with no invented pending-review gate.
Keep observations, athlete reports, objective evidence, inference and coach decisions distinct.
Never automatically overwrite an individual plan with a group practice.
